bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)" = 57955cd68bb39626ebbca38d44b7bb034da6dc05 || { echo LIVE_HEAD_CHANGED; exit 74; }
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
echo "GAYBBS_MENU_LINK_AUDIT_BEGIN"
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT 'NAV|'||chat_id||'|'||label||'|'||CASE WHEN enabled THEN 'ON' ELSE 'OFF' END||'|'||CASE WHEN destination_url ~ '^https://t.me/' THEN 'TELEGRAM' ELSE 'OTHER' END FROM board_posting_menu_links WHERE label IN ('雑談','紹介/招待') ORDER BY chat_id,label; SELECT 'GUIDE|'||chat_id||'|'||link_key||'|'||label||'|'||CASE WHEN enabled THEN 'ON' ELSE 'OFF' END FROM general_guide_links WHERE link_key IN ('community','freetalk') ORDER BY chat_id,link_key; SELECT 'ONLINE|'||card_key||'|'||enabled FROM online_gate_routes ORDER BY card_key; SELECT 'LINK_GATE|'||feature||'|'||enabled FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='link';" 2>/dev/null || echo DB_QUERY_FAILED
echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo "GAYBBS_MENU_LINK_AUDIT_END"
